executive_summary.problem_statement: The current TypeScript implementation of scenario discovery is a 'shallow module' that is tightly coupled to the local filesystem and performs sequential, fragile I/O. This makes it hard to extend to remote sources (S3, Git) and difficult to test without disk side-effects.
executive_summary.proposed_solution: Implement a standalone Rust library crate (qtip-catalog) using a Ports & Adapters architecture. This crate will provide a high-concurrency, unified interface for discovering, parsing, and validating qtip scenarios across diverse storage backends.
success_criteria: Performance: Concurrent parsing of 1,000 scenarios in < 500ms.
Reliability: 100% error collection (reports all malformed files in a single pass).
Extensibility: Zero changes required to core logic to add a new ScenarioSource (e.g., S3).
Testability: Core logic tested with 0% disk I/O using in-memory adapters.

user_personas: Engine Developer: Integrating the catalog into the core qtip runner.
DevOps Engineer: Configuring qtip to load scenarios from diverse sources in CI.

user_stories.benefit: so that I don't have to manage recursive directory walking or YAML parsing

user_stories.action: see a combined error report for all malformed scenarios
user_stories.benefit: so that I can fix all configuration issues in one iteration

user_stories.action: have the catalog respect .gitignore patterns automatically
user_stories.benefit: so that I don't run internal scratchpad scenarios by accident

acceptance_criteria: Implements the ScenarioCatalog and ScenarioSource traits as defined in the RFC.
Provides a FileSystemSource that supports recursive glob patterns and respects ignore files.
Provides a StandardScenarioCatalog implementation that handles parallel orchestration using tokio and rayon.
Error reporting uses a structured Vec<CatalogError> rather than failing fast.
Concurrency is throttled via a semaphore to prevent file handle exhaustion.
non_goals: Building the execution engine or the CLI in this crate.
Implementing remote S3/Git adapters in the MVP (only FileSystemSource).

technical_specifications.architecture_overview: Ports & Adapters pattern. Ports: ScenarioSource (discover/read) and ScenarioCatalog (find/get). Internal: ScenarioLoader orchestrating async Source I/O and parallel Rayon parsing.
security_privacy: Limit recursive depth to prevent traversal attacks.
Enforce semaphore-based limit (default: 100) on concurrent file reads.

phases.focus: Standalone crate, Traits defined, FileSystemSource, parallel parsing.
Integration of ignore crate for .gitignore support.
Addition of an InMemorySource for standard library testing.

risks: Async/Sync Bridge complexity (Tokio to Rayon data movement).
Resource exhaustion if semaphores are misconfigured.
